proceeding: Application of Rocky Mountain Power for Approval of a Large-Load Service Contract between PacifiCorp and a Large-Load Customer
how_obtained: Found the docket page on psc.utah.gov (a WordPress site: /<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/docket-no-<docket>/), read its raw HTML and pulled the pscdocs.utah.gov links out of it. Utah serves every document at a flat, guessable path: https://pscdocs.utah.gov/<utility>/<yy>docs/<docketdigits>/<docid><AbbreviatedTitle><m-d-yyyy>.pdf, with no login and no session. Downloaded with curl and extracted text with PyMuPDF sorted-block extraction (page.get_text('text', sort=True)), pages joined with a form feed (\x0c). No cleaning, reflow, de-hyphenation or whitespace normalisation.
version_role: the settlement the Commission then approved
notes: Read with the 2026-04-10 order it forms a settlement-then-order pair.
